clauses.text:
EXECUTIVE ORDER 9883
R evoking E xecutive  O rder N o. 9172 of  
May 22, 1942, E stablishing  a P anel 
for the  C reation  of E mergency  
Boards for the  A djustment  of  R ail ­
way L abor D isputes
WHEREAS ExeOutive Order No. 9172 
of May 22, 1942, established for the du­
ration of the war and six months there­
after a National Railway Labor Panel of 
nine members for the creation of emer- 
gency.boards for the adjustment of rail­
way labor disputes; and 
WHEREAS it appears that the pro­
cedures available ' under the Railway 
Labor Act are now adequate for the 
handling and adjustment of such dis­
putes:
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the 
authority vested in me by the Constitu­
tion and the statutes of the United 
States, it is ordered that the said Exec­
utive Order No. 9172 be, and it is hereby, 
revoked. -
